::: {#thm-prediction-error-residual}
#### Prediction error is the negative of the residual

For an observation $\iobs$,
the [prediction error](#def-prediction-error) of its [fitted value](#def-fitted-value)
is the negative of its [residual](#def-residual):

$$\prederr_\iobs = -\resid_\iobs.$$
:::

::: proof
This is the solution to @exr-prediction-error-residual.
:::
